"""API route handlers for the group_run application."""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from .models import Run, RunDetail, Participant, RunCreate, JoinRequest, LeaveRequest
from .store import run_store, run_detail_store, participant_store
from .errors import ApiError

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/runs", response_model=Run, status_code=201)
def post_runs(payload: RunCreate) -> Run:
    """Create a new run event from a RunCreate payload."""
    # Validate required fields
    if not payload.title or not payload.title.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Field 'title' is required and must be non-empty.")
    if not payload.datetime or not payload.datetime.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Field 'datetime' is required and must be non-empty.")
    if not payload.meeting_location or not payload.meeting_location.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Field 'meeting_location' is required and must be non-empty.")

    run_id = str(uuid4())

    run = Run(
        id=run_id,
        title=payload.title,
        datetime=payload.datetime,
        meeting_location=payload.meeting_location,
        distance=payload.distance,
        pace_target=payload.pace_target,
        route_notes=payload.route_notes,
        participant_count=0,
    )

    run_detail = RunDetail(
        id=run_id,
        title=payload.title,
        datetime=payload.datetime,
        meeting_location=payload.meeting_location,
        distance=payload.distance,
        pace_target=payload.pace_target,
        route_notes=payload.route_notes,
        participants=[],
        participant_count=0,
    )

    run_store[run_id] = run
    run_detail_store[run_id] = run_detail

    return run


@router.get("/runs", response_model=list[Run])
def get_runs() -> list[Run]:
    """List all runs sorted by datetime in lexical order."""
    runs = list(run_store.values())
    runs.sort(key=lambda r: r.datetime or "")
    return runs


@router.get("/runs/{run_id}", response_model=RunDetail)
def get_runs_run_id(run_id: str) -> RunDetail:
    """Retrieve a single RunDetail including the participant list."""
    if run_id not in run_detail_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run with id '{run_id}' was not found.")
    return run_detail_store[run_id]


@router.post("/runs/{run_id}/join", response_model=RunDetail, status_code=200)
def post_runs_run_id_join(run_id: str, payload: JoinRequest) -> RunDetail:
    """Join a run by participant name. Rejects duplicate names case-insensitively."""
    if not payload.name or not payload.name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Participant name is required and must be non-empty.")

    if run_id not in run_detail_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run with id '{run_id}' was not found.")

    run_detail = run_detail_store[run_id]
    normalized_name = payload.name.strip().lower()

    # Check for duplicate (case-insensitive)
    for p in run_detail.participants:
        if p.name.strip().lower() == normalized_name:
            raise ApiError("duplicate_name", f"Participant '{payload.name}' is already joined to this run.")

    participant = Participant(
        name=payload.name.strip(),
        joined_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    )

    run_detail.participants.append(participant)
    run_detail.participant_count = len(run_detail.participants)

    # Update the Run in run_store to keep participant_count in sync
    if run_id in run_store:
        run_store[run_id].participant_count = run_detail.participant_count

    # Track in participant_store using a composite key
    part_key = f"{run_id}:{normalized_name}"
    participant_store[part_key] = participant

    return run_detail


@router.post("/runs/{run_id}/leave", response_model=RunDetail, status_code=200)
def post_runs_run_id_leave(run_id: str, payload: LeaveRequest) -> RunDetail:
    """Leave a run by participant name. Returns error if name not found."""
    if not payload.name or not payload.name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Participant name is required and must be non-empty.")

    if run_id not in run_detail_store:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run with id '{run_id}' was not found.")

    run_detail = run_detail_store[run_id]
    normalized_name = payload.name.strip().lower()

    # Find and remove the participant (case-insensitive match)
    found_index = None
    for i, p in enumerate(run_detail.participants):
        if p.name.strip().lower() == normalized_name:
            found_index = i
            break

    if found_index is None:
        raise ApiError("participant_not_found", f"Participant '{payload.name}' is not joined to this run.")

    run_detail.participants.pop(found_index)
    run_detail.participant_count = len(run_detail.participants)

    # Sync run_store
    if run_id in run_store:
        run_store[run_id].participant_count = run_detail.participant_count

    # Remove from participant_store
    part_key = f"{run_id}:{normalized_name}"
    participant_store.pop(part_key, None)

    return run_detail
